s: Etzim haasurim vehammuttarim beyom tob ubo y"ch seipim. En mebaqqein etzim min haqqorot haomedot lebinyan, mippene shehen muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis, sheadam maqpid alehen millehassiqan, uben hashshemashot lo haya dato alehen lehesseq (ayyen simman sh"[ch] seip k"v). Velo miqqora shennishbera beyom tob, mishshum deetmol lo haya yodea shettishshaber velo haya dato aleha lehesseq, vaapillu lehammattirin muqtzeh venolad beyom tob — modim bemuqtzeh gadol kazeh, deqora beria vachazaqa enah asuya kelal lehishshaber. Abal im hayeta reua meereb yom tob uqeroba lehishshaber, kevan shehaya yodea shettishshaber vedato aleha lehassaqa, laken muttar lebaqqeot mimmenna lehammattirim nolad beyom tob. Abal lehaoserim nolad beyom tob — asur lebaqqeot mimmenna, deetmol haya keli shalem rauy limlakto, dehaynu binyan, vehayyom hi sheber keli, vahare zeh nolad beyom tob. Ukebar nitbaer deyesh lehachamir benolad beyom tob.

Abal im nishbera meereb yom tob, im i epshar lehassiqah belo biqqua mechamat godlah veobyah — muttar lebaqqeot mimmenna chatikot gedolot veap al pi shehaya epshar lo lebaqqeot meereb yom tob, lepi sheen bibqiat etzim lachatikot gedolot melaka gemura, veap beshabbat eno asur ella middibre soperim mishshum obadin dechol, umishshum simchat yom tob hittiru legamre. Abal asur lebaqqeot mimmenna chatikot qetannot meod kederek shemmebaqqeim etzim daqqim meod kede lehatztzit bahen haur, mippene shehaoseh ken beshabbat chayyab, mippene shehu toledet hattochen, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"a, lepikak lo hittiru dabar zeh mishshum simchat yom tob, lepi shezzehu kemakshirin sheepshar laasotam meereb yom tob.

Ukeshehu mebaqqea — lo yebaqqa beqardom, velo bemaggal, velo bimgera, kederek shemmebaqqea bechol, dekevan shehaya epshar lebaqqeot meereb yom tob — hitzrikuhu chakamim leshannot shello yebaqqa ella beqopitz (perush: sakkin shel qatztzabim veyesh osim bo shene rashim vedomeh qetzat leqardom), ubatztzad haqqatzar shello, abal lo batztzad harachab, kede leshannot. Veakshav sheen anu beqiim mahu qardom umahu qopitz — yesh lehachamir shello lebaqqeot ella besakkin o beyad.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beetzim gedolim meod, shei epshar lehassiqan kelal belo biqqua, kegon qora vekayyotze bah, abal etzim shel hassaqa shehen gedolim qetzat ureuyim lehassaqa belo biqqua — lo yebaqqeem kelal apillu besakkin, kevan sheepshar lehassiqan belo biqqua — hare zeh tircha sheenah tzerika. Velaken yesh lehachamir shello leshabberan apillu beyad, apillu lachatikot gedolot, beinyan sheen leesor mishshum toledet tochen. Veken lo yaknis haetz bechor kede leshabbero, kevan sheepshar lehassiqo kemo shehu.

Vehamdaqdeqim nohagim leesor habbiqqua shel etzim hareuyim lehassaqa beli biqqua apillu bechol hammoed, umetaqqenim umekinim kol haetzim haqqetannim hatztzerikim lebishshul dagim qodem yom tob, dechosheshin letircha sheenah tzerika, shehare yakol lebaaram belo biqqua. Veken nakon lehachamir. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom shehaetzim yeqarim, deyesh hepsed merubbeh im natzrik lehabir beli biqqua — muttar lo lebaqqea bammoed apillu etzim sheepshar lehassiqan belo biqqua. Bammeh debarim amurim? Lebaqqeot bikli, abal leshabber beyad, kevan sheeno oseh kederek shehu oseh bechol — en lehachamir bo kelal bammoed, apillu bimqomot sheen haetzim yeqarim.

Etzim hampuzzarin bechatzer, ben shehem gedolim ben shehem qetannim — asur legabbeban beyom tob, mippene shennireh kimlaqqet letzorek chol, shekken derek legabbeb hayyom letzorek machar. Abal im rotzeh lebashshel qederato bechatzer — muttar legabbeb samuk limqom bishshul qederato, mippene sheqqederato mokachat alayv sheeno megabbeb letzorek machar. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beetzim hampuzzarin, abal etzim hamkunnasim birshut hayyachid — muttar littol mehen uleholikan apillu lechatzer acheret ulehassiqan sham.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechatzer, abal bassadeh asur lelaqqet etzim, apillu rotzeh lebashshel qederato bassadeh ulelaqqet etzim samuk limqom bishshul qederato, lepi shedderek etzim lihyot gedelim bassadeh, vehamlaqqet sham etzim nireh kimammer dabar bimqom giddulo (ayyen simman sh"m). Ukebar nitbaer besimman ttz"h shehaimmur hu mimmelakot shello hutteru letzorek "okel nepesh", ulepikak apillu min hamkunnasim shebbassadeh asur liqqach, gezera shemma yiqqach min hampuzzarin, venireh kimammer.

Qarpep, shehu maqom hammuqqap mechitztzot ap al pi sheeno muqqap ledira, im yesh lo misgeret, o shehu omed betok shibim amma ved' tepachim lair, kevan shehu maqom hammishtammer — hare hu kechatzer, umuttar lehabi min haetzim hamkunnasim shebbetoko. Abal im en lo misgeret veeno omed betok shibim amma ved' tepachim lair, kevan sheeno maqom hammishtammer — hare hu kemi sheeno muqqap mechitztzot kelal, veen mebiin mimmennu etzim apillu min hamkunnasim shebbetoko.

Ale qanim vaale gepanim shehen mekunnasim umunnachim baqqarpep, ap al pi sheyyesh lo misgeret veomed betok shibim amma ved' tepachim lair — hare hen kimpuzzarim veasur liqqach mehen beyom tob, mippene sheanu chosheshim shemma yepazzerem haruach beshaa sheyyabo liqqach otam veyabo lelaqqetam. Veim hinniach alehem keli kabed meereb yom tob shello yepazzerem haruach — muttar liqqach mehen beyom tob.

Etzim shennasheru min hailan beyom tob — en massiqin bahen beyom tob apillu lehammattirin nolad beyom tob, lepi shehen biklal gezerat perot hannosherin mealehen beshabbat o beyom tob, sheasarum chakamim bo bayyom baakila ubetiltul, mishshum gezera shemma yaaleh veyitlosh, kemo shennitbaer besimman shak"[h]. Veim napelu letok hattannur — yitbaer besimman tq"z beezrat Hashem.

Kebar nitbaer sheyyesh lehachamir benolad beyom tob, lepikak kelim shennishberu beyom tob veen osin meen melaktan harishona kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h — en massiqin bahen mippene shehen nolad, vaasurin betiltul. Vaapillu lesorpan bimqoman asur ap al pi sheeno metaltelan, lepi shehammuqtzeh asur lehishtammesh bo velehanot mimmennu, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"t.
Veken nokri shechaqaq bet qibbul bibqaat beyom tob — hare asaa keli, veen massiqin bah, mippene shehu nolad.

Abal massiqin bekelim shelemim shennaasu meereb yom tob, ap al pi shehu neheneh min hakkeli leachar shehudlaq miqtzato venaasa sheber keli — en bekak kelum kevan shehahanaa baa lo meeleha, sheeno oseh shum maaseh begup hammuqtzeh, ayyen sop simman tq"t. Abal asur lahapok baesh leachar shehudlaq miqtzato, deaz naasa sheber keli, veketzad hu oseh? Marbeh alehem etzim mukanim umassiqan, deaz yakol lahapok baesh ap leachar shehudlequ miqtzat min hakkelim, lepi shehen betelim berob etzim hammukanim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"z beezrat Hashem.
Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen lo etzim mukanim kede kol tzorko, abal im yesh lo kede kol tzorko — asur lehassiq bekelim shelemim apillu bechol, mippene shehu ober al "bal tashchit".

Keli shennishbar meereb yom tob veen alayv toar keli — muttar lehassiqo beyom tob, shehare hu kebar mukan veomed lehassaqa. Veim yesh alayv toar keli venishbar beyom tob — asur lehassiqo beyom tob, mippene shehu nolad.

Hakkelim vehaokalin metaltelin otan lekol dabar, veen omerim: lo nittenu hakkelim ella letashmishan vehaokalin ella laakila, ulepikak massiqin beegozim usheqedim. Veim akalan beyom tob — en massiqin biqlippehen apillu hen reuyim lemaakal behema, mippene sheetmol hayu mechubbarim utepelim lehaokel venechshabin kaokel atzmo, veakshav en nechshabin keokel kelal, vahare zeh nolad.
Etz shemmechattin bo haesh, kevan shehu meyuchad lekak — hare hu keli, veim nishbar beyom tob — asur lehassiqo, kemo shennitbaer.

Yom tob shechal lihyot achar shabbat — asur lehadliq beyom tob shiyyure hallappidim vehappetilot shennidlequ vekabu beshabbat, ella im ken nidlequ vekabu paam achat qodem hashshabbat, mippene shehem yoter nochim lehadliq keshennidlequ kebar paam achat vekabu, shehaur neechaz bahen heteb, venimtza shehakkebiyya shennikbu beshabbat hi maksheret umekina otam lehadlaqa beyom tob, veen shabbat mekina leyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"g ayyen sham. Lepikak, asur lehadliqan beyom tob apillu batztzad hashsheni shello nidlaq adayin, gezera shemma yadleq beoto tzad shennidlaq kebar venikba beshabbat. Vekevan sheasur lehadliqan beyom tob — yesh al shiyyure happetila din keli shemmelakto leissur, sheen letaltelo ki im letzorek gupo o meqomo kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Abal shiyyure hallappidim kevan sheen reuyim lehassaqa beyom tob — asur letaltelam apillu letzorek gupan umeqoman, lepi sheen alehem torat keli kelal. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom tob rishon, abal yom tob sheni shel galuyyot shechal lihyot bemotzae shabbat — muttar lehadliqan batztzad hashsheni shello nidlaq adayin, dekevan sheyyom tob sheni eno ella middibre soperim — lo gazeru shemma yadliq batztzad shennidlaq kebar. Vekevan shehen reuyim lehadlaqa — muttar gam ken letaltelan kedin keli shemmelakto lehetter shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Abal yom tob sheni shechal besheni beshabbat umimmennu veelak — muttar lehadliq bo shiyyure petilot velappidim apillu beoto tzad shennidlequ bo beyom tob rishon. Vaapillu beyom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana muttar lehadliq, mimma napshak: im yom sheni chol — muttar lehadliq bo kemo bechol, veim hu qodesh veyom rishon chol — kol shekken shemmuttar, shehare chol mekin leyom tob, veim shenehem qedoshim — im ken hare hen qedushsha achat, shehare keyom echad arok hen chashubim, veen shayyak kan issur hakana miyyom tob lachabero kevan shehen yom echad. Veyesh omerim daapillu beyom tob rishon shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat muttar lehadliq shiyyure hallappidim vehappetilot shennidlequ vekabu beshabbat, lepi sheen kebiyya zo chashuba hakana gemura, kevan sheggup happetila kebar haya baolam, ella sheal yede kebiyya zo hi nocha yoter lehadliq, veen bezeh keday leesor et gup happetila vehallappidim. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lachush lisbara harishona velaasot petilot chadashot. Veim hayshana munnachat al pi hanner — muttar lehotziah mishsham kede lehanniach acheret bimqomah, dekevan deissur tiltul eno ella middibre soperim — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona.
